title: MOFF2: A Transferable Coarse-Grained Protein Force Field for Predictive Condensate Simulations.
authors: Liu, Shuming; Zhang, Yumeng; Riveros, Ivan; Wang, Cong; Zhang, Bin
journal: Journal of chemical theory and computation
one_liner_zh: 该文提出可迁移的粗粒化蛋白质力场MOFF2，结合残基对特异相互作用与密度依赖多体势，通过数据驱动优化实现折叠蛋白、无序蛋白及多域蛋白的构象和凝聚体模拟，属于蛋白质结构计算中的物理模拟方法创新。
abstract: Coarse-grained (CG) protein force fields enable simulations of biomolecular systems at length and time scales that are difficult to access with atomistic models, but achieving transferability across folded, intrinsically disordered, and multidomain proteins (MDPs) remains challenging. A central difficulty is that one-bead-per-residue models must represent chemically specific residue interactions while also absorbing solvent-mediated and many-body effects into a simplified energy function. Here, we present MOFF2, a transferable coarse-grained protein force field that combines residue-pair-specific interactions with a density-dependent many-body potential. MOFF2 is optimized using a two-stage strategy: bottom-up parameter learning from heterogeneous reference ensembles followed by refinement against experimental conformational observables. The resulting model provides balanced performance across ordered proteins (OPs), intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs), and multidomain proteins, and predicts condensate saturation-concentration trends for A1-LCD variant systems. Analysis of the learned parameters reveals chemically interpretable interaction patterns and density-dependent effects that explain the model's improved transferability. These results demonstrate that combining a generalized coarse-grained energy function with data-driven optimization can produce a practical and interpretable force field for protein conformational and condensate simulations.
abstract_zh: 粗粒化（CG）蛋白质力场使得在原子模型难以企及的长度和时间尺度上模拟生物分子系统成为可能，但在折叠蛋白、 intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 和多结构域蛋白（MDPs）之间实现可转移性仍具挑战。核心难点在于，单珠每残基模型必须表示化学特异性残基相互作用，同时将溶剂介导效应和多体效应吸收到简化能量函数中。在此，我们提出MOFF2，一种可转移的粗粒化蛋白质力场，结合了残基对特异性相互作用与密度依赖性多体势。MOFF2采用两阶段策略优化：首先从异质参考系综进行自下而上的参数学习，随后针对实验构象观测量进行细化。所得模型在有序蛋白（OPs）、 intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 和多结构域蛋白间提供均衡性能，并预测A1-LCD变体系统的凝聚体饱和浓度趋势。对学习参数的分析揭示了化学上可解释的相互作用模式和密度依赖性效应，这些解释了模型改进的可转移性。这些结果表明，将广义粗粒化能量函数与数据驱动优化相结合，可产生实用且可解释的力场，用于蛋白质构象和凝聚体模拟。
